restricciones.definicion: FOREIGN KEY (lead_id) REFERENCES crm.leads(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (reservado_por) REFERENCES public.perfiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (cliente_id) REFERENCES public.perfiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (
CASE estado
    WHEN 'pendiente'::text THEN ((resuelta_por IS NULL) AND (tasa_maxima_autorizada IS NULL) AND (respondida_por_analista_en IS NULL) AND (consumida_en IS NULL))
    WHEN 'rechazada'::text THEN ((resuelta_por IS NOT NULL) AND (tasa_maxima_autorizada IS NULL) AND (consumida_en IS NULL))
    WHEN 'aprobada'::text THEN ((resuelta_por IS NOT NULL) AND (tasa_maxima_autorizada = tasa_solicitada) AND (consumida_en IS NULL))
    WHEN 'aprobada_con_tope'::text THEN ((resuelta_por IS NOT NULL) AND (tasa_maxima_autorizada < tasa_solicitada) AND (respondida_por_analista_en IS NULL) AND (consumida_en IS NULL))
    WHEN 'aceptada_por_analista'::text THEN ((resuelta_por IS NOT NULL) AND (tasa_maxima_autorizada < tasa_solicitada) AND (respondida_por_analista_en IS NOT NULL) AND (consumida_en IS NULL))
    WHEN 'declinada_por_analista'::text THEN ((resuelta_por IS NOT NULL) AND (tasa_maxima_autorizada < tasa_solicitada) AND (respondida_por_analista_en IS NOT NULL) AND (consumida_en IS NULL))
    WHEN 'consumida'::text THEN ((resuelta_por IS NOT NULL) AND (tasa_maxima_autorizada IS NOT NULL) AND (consumida_en IS NOT NULL) AND (contrato_id IS NOT NULL))
    WHEN 'vencida'::text THEN (consumida_en IS NULL)
    ELSE false
END)
FOREIGN KEY (lead_id) REFERENCES crm.leads(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((((categoria = 'nuevo'::text) AND (contrato_origen_id IS NULL)) OR ((categoria <> 'nuevo'::text) AND (contrato_origen_id IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (politica_id) REFERENCES crm.politica_rentabilidad(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (resuelta_por) REFERENCES public.perfiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (solicitada_por) REFERENCES public.perfiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (((cliente_id IS NOT NULL) OR (lead_id IS NOT NULL)))
CHECK (((tasa_maxima_autorizada IS NULL) OR ((tasa_maxima_autorizada > (0)::numeric) AND (tasa_maxima_autorizada <= (50)::numeric) AND (scale(tasa_maxima_autorizada) <= 2))))
CHECK (((tasa_maxima_autorizada IS NULL) OR ((tasa_maxima_autorizada > tasa_base) AND (tasa_maxima_autorizada <= tasa_solicitada))))
CHECK ((((sha256 IS NULL) AND (bytes IS NULL)) OR ((sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'::text) AND (bytes > 0) AND (bytes <= 10485760))))
FOREIGN KEY (contrato_id) REFERENCES public.contratos(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((((estado = ANY (ARRAY['procesando'::text, 'subido_verificado'::text])) AND (lease_token IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expira_en IS NOT NULL)) OR ((estado <> ALL (ARRAY['procesando'::text, 'subido_verificado'::text])) AND (lease_token IS NULL) AND (lease_expira_en IS NULL))))
CHECK ((((estado = 'sellado'::text) AND (sellado_en IS NOT NULL)) OR ((estado <> 'sellado'::text) AND (sellado_en IS NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (solicitado_por) REFERENCES public.perfiles(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((((estado = ANY (ARRAY['pendiente'::text, 'procesando'::text])) AND (sha256 IS NULL) AND (bytes IS NULL) AND (subido_en IS NULL)) OR ((estado = ANY (ARRAY['subido_verificado'::text, 'sellado'::text])) AND (sha256 IS NOT NULL) AND (bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (subido_en IS NOT NULL)) OR (estado = ANY (ARRAY['error_reintentable'::text, 'integridad_bloqueada'::text]))))
